Biwa Hayahide runs into frame
That reminds me, Trainer. What does your schedule look like tonight?

In other words, what I wanted to say is...
—I would like to go to the festival with you.
—Toward completing our "Formula for Victory"!

Heh... You seem to think I'm a complete and utter
training fanatic. Well, that's not entirely wrong, though.

She surely will not choose her path. No matter how steep it is,
she will polish those wondrous legs she was born with... and reach the top.

Hm? ...I'm not quite sure what you mean, but no problem.
Alright, 10 minutes are up. Let's resume our training.

Tell me, Trainer?
Heheh...
—To become the me that you acknowledged.

Yes. Come to think of it, I realized that since this training camp started,
I haven't talked with you outside of coordinating our workouts.

—For an intuitive Umamusume, this is around the time tangible results begin to show.
Naturally, Biwa Hayahide seems to feel that as well...

During the time trials to measure her rate of growth,
Biwa Hayahide showcased a run that made her look like a whole new person...

At a stage where she has begun racing, continuing steady basic training
while watching those around her transform dramatically could easily cause impatience.

...Seeing how composed she is, perhaps my worries
were groundless. Just as I was thinking that—

Beyond Biwa Hayahide's gaze stretches the horizon.
Though it may seem far away, I know that she will reach it one day.
Understood.
Ah...! Done!

Whoa, that's amazing! Best one I've ever seen!
You hung in there with sheer tenacity—a hard-fought victory!

Heh... Indeed.
Challenging it until I can derive the perfect solution is my aesthetic, after all.
...! Right, here we go!

Where Biwa Hayahide brought me was
a summer festival being held near the training camp grounds.

With the summer training camp underway, Biwa Hayahide was diligently working
on beach core training with the goal of raising her baseline capabilities.

Ah~ no good on this one. The fish's tail is in pieces, too bad!
Come give it another shot sometime!

In the smile Biwa Hayahide gave, there was no sign of giving up.
It was a radiant smile born from facing herself and accepting who she is.

After strolling around and enjoying the festival for a while,
the two of us ended up trying our hand at "katanuki" candy carving, but...

In short, I wanted to say there is no need to worry.
I, too, am growing every day, both mentally and physically.

I was literally asking about your plans for tonight.
If you have nothing scheduled, there is somewhere I'd like you to accompany me.

Ah... It appears so. Because my theory is constructed so perfectly,
whenever things don't work out, I end up getting impatient and overly fired up.

This is what we found together...
our formula for growth leading to victory.
(Tap, tap, tap... tap)

It might be early, but I'd like to talk with you to review our progress.
...No, wait. Including a review would blur our definitions.

Because I wasn't extraordinary, I had no choice but to struggle.
And so, I discovered theory as my weapon, polished it, and became who I am today.

Those with innate talent who also put in the effort... like my sister, for instance,
can probably prove that formula in the fastest time possible.

...In the end, no matter how flawless a formula one constructs,
if one's own capability cannot keep up, it remains nothing more than an array of numbers.

Devoting myself to the basics seems to have paid off.
As expected, this methodology suits me best.

But not me. Only after calculating the shortest distance, removing obstacles,
and preparing the optimal running environment... can I finally stand at the starting line.

It was a flawless training plan crafted together by the two of us to deliver consistent results in the future.
However, coming into the final stretch of the training camp—

Damn it... Another failure. Theoretically speaking, as long as I
pay attention to the pressure along the grooves, it should clear without issue...

I even reshaped the toothpick I'm using. Dust management was flawless.
In that case... it must be an adjustment issue with my force application.
Yeah, leave it to me!
—Ah!
Alright...!

And that is how it is. I will conquer this katanuki without fail.
Victory is already in sight. This time, I will definitively—execute it!
*Pant*... *pant*...! How was that, Trainer!?

Yes, good work to you as well, Trainer.
Shall we head back to the lodge?

Yeah, you beat your time by a wide margin! Compared to when the camp started,
you're steadily getting faster. Let's keep this momentum going!

Therefore, this is fine. Even if I cannot reach it immediately,
I will trust in my weapon and push forward with honest diligence. That is my path.
And then, after several attempts, finally—!
Hmph... Haaaaah—!

True to her word, Biwa Hayahide straightforwardly adhered to the plan,
continuing her core training—

...Alright, that wraps up today's entire routine.
Right on schedule, nothing missing and nothing redundant. Yes, perfection.
And then, the final day of the training camp finally arrived.

I did it, Trainer!
Look, I carved the shape out cleanly!

However—that is quite alright.
After all, "this is simply who I am."

—How was it, Trainer?
Now that all the numbers are in... have we met our targets?

Biwa Hayahide's gaze gently drifted upward. Looking up at the sky along with her,
there were dazzling bright stars, as well as stars so faint you would miss them unless you strained your eyes.
(Tap, tap, tap, tap... Snap!)

—*Phew*... That's finished, Trainer.
High-knee drills on the sand are truly grueling, however...
